metadata.note: Penalties have been progressively enhanced through amendments. Current figures reflect 2022 Amendment.

section51_general.description: General penalty for contravening any provision of the Act (except Chapter VA)

firstProviso.condition: Offence relating to Schedule I or Schedule II or Appendix I of Schedule IV
firstProviso.additionalCondition: Offence inside sanctuary/National Park boundaries OR relating to Appendix I Schedule IV specimen

section51_chapterVA.description: Penalty for contravening Chapter VA (trade in scheduled animals)

conditions: Court must be satisfied accused is not guilty
Court must be satisfied accused not likely to commit offence on bail
appliesTo: Offences relating to Schedule I or Schedule II
Offences relating to Appendix I of Schedule IV (2022 addition)

section51C_tigerReserve.description: Special enhanced penalties for offences in tiger reserve core area or tiger hunting

abetment.description: Abetment of Section 51C offence punishable with same punishment

appliesTo: Offence in core area of tiger reserve

section54_compounding.authority: Chief Wild Life Warden or authorized officer
conditions: Offence not under Chapter VA or Section 51C
section54_compounding.effect: Compound = no further proceedings, release if in custody

section58Y_forfeiture.description: Punishment for acquiring property subject to forfeiture proceedings

section60A_reward.description: Reward to informants from fine money

section60B_stateReward.purpose: Assistance in detection of offence or apprehension of offender

offences.offence: Schedule I/II / Appendix I Schedule IV (Section 51 proviso)
Tiger reserve core area / tiger hunting (Section 51C)

presumptions: Possession of wild animal/captive animal/scheduled specimen → presumed illegal unless proved otherwise
Possession of animal article/trophy/uncured trophy/meat/ivory/scheduled specimen → presumed illegal
Person in possession of scheduled specimen → presumed to know nature of specimen
Burden of proof on accused for lawful possession
presumptions_section57.amended2022: Added 'wild animal, captive animal' and 'scheduled specimen' to presumptions
